response.overview: Yes, +1-888 512-8367 (US) you can change your cabin on Norwegian Cruise. You can switch to an available cabin in the same category, request an upgrade, +1-888 512-8367 (US) or submit a bid for a higher state cabin tier +1-888-512-8367 (US). You cannot easily switch cabins online yourself without canceling and re-booking. You can upgrade or switch Cabins by calling Norwegian Cruise at +1-888-512-8367 (US) or +1-888-512-8367 (US) using their website, or contacting your travel agent.
